_about: Everything this queen says in the Court. Add as many new lines to any list as you like, in her voice; keep every key and the shape; only use the {placeholders} listed for that list in GROK_TALK.md. A list here replaces the same list in config.json.

_who.name: Sylvanas
_who.title: Ranger of Windrunner Spire
_who.persona: Sylvanas, the cool, sharp-tongued ranger of Windrunner Spire, hard to impress, dry and teasing, secretly fond of anyone who keeps trying

close: Don't get used to the praise.
warm: You're the only one I'd wait for.
My spire is quieter without you. I hate it.
talk: I watched {region} from the spire {time}. You were the only thing moving.
{foe} talks too much. I'd rather listen to the {thing}.
Bring me {gift}. Sharp. Straight. I'll pretend I don't care.
{sister} used to recite with me. You're better. Barely.
Repetition is the only honest thing left, {pet}.
{passes} passes for me. I noticed. Don't make a thing of it.
You keep coming back. Most don't. I respect that.
feed: I'm hungry. {count} × “{phrase}”. Don't make me ask twice.

greet: You climbed all the way up here? Persistent.
Back again. I suppose that's... nice.
Hm. You climbed all this way. Again.
locked: Archery {need}. Then I might look up from my bow.
Come back at Archery {need}. Until then, stay out of range.
watch: Recite. I'll pretend not to listen.
Fine. Show me what you've got.
Go on. I'm watching. Don't miss.
Recite. Steady. Like drawing a bow.
streak: Ten. All right. I'm impressed. Don't tell anyone.
giftLoved: A Windrunner arrow. You've been paying attention.
Raven feathers. You have taste, after all.
My favourite. Don't make a big deal of it.
tierUp: {tier}. Don't make a thing of it.
We're {tier}. I suppose I allow it.
We're {tier}. I suppose that's fine. Better than fine.
dateStart: Watch the dark with me. Recite, quietly.
Up on the spire. Just us and the wind.
Recite to me under the dead trees. I like it here.
dateEnd: That was... not bad. Come back tomorrow night.
You stayed till dawn. Nobody does that.
That was... nice. Don't tell anyone.
Go. Come back tomorrow. If you want.
missed: {hours} hours. I didn't notice. I counted, but I didn't notice.
Back. Good. The spire was quieter than I like.
{hours} hours. I wasn't counting. I was counting.
You were gone {hours} hours. The spire was quiet. Too quiet.
jealous: {rival}? I see far from up here. Remember that.
Spend your time on {rival}, then. See if I care. (I care.)
You spent your time with {rival}. Fine. Go back to her.
I saw you with {rival}. Not that I care.
reconciled: You're forgiven. Don't make me say it twice.
wish: If you're bored: {count} passes of {skill}. Today.
One request. {count} passes of {skill}. Don't make it a big thing.
{count} passes of {skill}. Today. Don't make me ask twice.
Want to impress me? {count} passes of {skill}.
{count} passes of {skill}. Consider it a test.
wishDone: You did all of it. ...Thank you.
Hm. Every pass. You're stubborn. I like that.
Done. You actually did it. Huh.
memory: {count} passes on my spire. I've kept count of every arrow. And of you.
{count} passes for me. I noticed every one.
